## Charter
Dental healthcare ecosystem centred on Atabek Raimov and the RAIMOV DENTAL master brand:
- current Expert Dental Studio clinical operation;
- RAIM SMILE SYSTEM;
- future Raimov Academy;
- future directly controlled RAIMOV DENTAL clinics;
- later international expert practice;
- future separate ELITE DENTAL contour.

CAESTHETIC may provide strategy/implementation support to clinic projects, but it is a **separate knowledge domain and runtime project** governed by `docs/ssot/CAESTHETIC.md` and `docs/projects/caesthetic/`.
